state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q2: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-04-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q5: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q6: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: daily meal allowance a standard travel day with an approved client dinner
state.step_intent: Find the daily meal allowance that applies to: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today?

passages.source: HB-13 §3 | Travel policy: meals — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-18
passages.text: For a day with an approved client dinner, 31 EUR per day is added to the standard daily meal allowance. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location.

passages.source: HB-18 §3 | Travel policy: meals — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-04-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-13
passages.text: For a day with an approved client dinner, 31 EUR per day was added to the standard daily meal allowance. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim.

passages.source: HB-06 §2 | Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions — Exception for client-site days in London or Paris | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: For client-site days in London or Paris, the daily meal allowance is 78 EUR per day instead of the standard amount. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-18 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-04-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-13
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel was 47 EUR per day. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.source: HB-13 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-18
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel is 45 EUR per day. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location.
